scope: Post-run source/policy clarification. No frozen wrapper/harness/library/raw record changed. Local installed8.1.0 source was inspected; actual Linux8.1.0 fresh no-network connection introspection independently confirmed budget0/empty retry_on_error. This is not a historical live retry/reconnect counter.

original_raw_field.interpretation: Harness caller-retry intent; not a measured all-library/network retry/reconnect count.

source_chain: Redis.__init__ only injects its default retry object when no connection pool is supplied.
The pool forwards URL/kwargs; this harness supplies no retry/retry_on_error/retry_on_timeout policy and requires protocol=3.
AbstractConnection defaults retry=None and empty retry_on_error, selecting Retry(NoBackoff(),0).
Command and pipeline execution call connection.retry.call_with_retry; zero retries raises after the first supported failure instead of replaying the operation.
reconnect_scope: Pool checkout can disconnect/reconnect and revalidate a dirty/disconnected connection before sending a command; maintenance notifications can mark/reconnect connections. This is separate from replaying SQL/a Redis operation.
fault_observation_scope: All native trial success markers passed, but no dedicated wire-level retry/reconnect/fault counter was instrumented; do not equate successful operations with a universal zero-network-retry guarantee.
future_harness_followup: Explicitly configure Retry(NoBackoff(),0), record/verify the resolved command policy, rename metadata to caller_operation_retries, and label connection/reconnect policy separately. Any client warmup/PING change is a new timed harness/source and needs new frozen comparisons; never silently rewrite these raw labels.

post_run_Linux_observation.scope: post-run no-network connection policy introspection; reconnect management differs from command replay
